name: teamLab Planets
description: An immersive water-filled digital art museum in Toyosu where visitors walk barefoot through water pools and flower gardens.
reservation: Mandatory online timed entry ticket; walk-ins rarely available.
parking: No dedicated parking; paid parking available near Shin-Toyosu Station.
notes: Wear barefoot-friendly clothing that can be rolled up above knees for knee-deep water exhibits.
